description.value: A 24-hour Subway franchise located in Burnaby on Hastings Street, offering customizable Footlong and 6-inch sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-cut vegetables and freshly baked bread. The location features both indoor and outdoor seating and accepts multiple payment methods including major credit cards. Its round-the-clock hours make it a potential stop for cyclists at any time of day.
